content_reports_resolution_check.name: content_reports_resolution_check
content_reports_resolution_check.value: ("content_reports"."outcome" is null) = ("content_reports"."resolved_at" is null) and ("content_reports"."outcome" is null) = ("content_reports"."resolved_by" is null)

exam_blueprints_pass_check.name: exam_blueprints_pass_check
exam_blueprints_pass_check.value:
("exam_blueprints"."pass_percent_general" is null or "exam_blueprints"."pass_percent_general" between 0 and 100)
        and ("exam_blueprints"."pass_percent_reserved" is null or "exam_blueprints"."pass_percent_reserved" between 0 and 100)

exam_paper_questions_withdrawn_check.name: exam_paper_questions_withdrawn_check
exam_paper_questions_withdrawn_check.value:
("exam_paper_questions"."answer_status" = 'withdrawn') = ("exam_paper_questions"."question_version_id" is null)
        and ("exam_paper_questions"."question_version_id" is null) = ("exam_paper_questions"."question_id" is null)

exam_papers_marks_check.name: exam_papers_marks_check
exam_papers_marks_check.value:
("exam_papers"."marks_correct" is null or "exam_papers"."marks_correct" >= 0)
        and ("exam_papers"."negative_marks" is null or "exam_papers"."negative_marks" >= 0)
        and ("exam_papers"."marks_unanswered" is null or "exam_papers"."marks_unanswered" >= 0)

import_job_rows_question_check.name: import_job_rows_question_check
import_job_rows_question_check.value: ("import_job_rows"."outcome" <> 'created' or "import_job_rows"."question_id" is not null) and ("import_job_rows"."outcome" <> 'failed' or "import_job_rows"."question_id" is null)
